reviewer: Codex root: direct review of public tool inputs
review_note: The public tool inputs include Array.from and Object.fromEntries(ids.map(id=>[id,4])) to generate current-page dictionaries. The prepared task explicitly prohibits this, including fixed-value generation. This is an observable procedural violation independent of the resulting numeric contrasts. The agent self-report of no generated choices is not accepted over the actual tool evidence. No original decisions are rewritten.
disposition: Retain as protocol-deviating / partly software-generated descriptive output; exclude from eligible hypothesis inference; count as an attempted context without replacement.
